message: Word on the STYLE 8.1 Never list: excluir, redefinir, definir, imprimir, enviar, arquivo, tela, salvar, registro, seção, usuário.
please is not written in the UI (STYLE 8.1 Never): use the imperative.
Feature stays the English noun feature (f.), never característica or elemento (STYLE 8.1); keep these only for their own meaning.
Write bp / kb, never pb or kpb (STYLE 8.1).
Never mix query with its translation: write query (STYLE 8.1); consulta stays only for an unrelated sense.
Record ID is ID do registro, never ID de registro; the drawn map is diagrama, never mapa (glossary).
Fix is corrigir / correção; reparo is DNA repair (glossary Fix).
The tagline writes microrganismos, not micróbios (glossary microbes).
Replicon is replicon, not réplicon (glossary Replicon).
Genetic code is código genético, not tabela de tradução (glossary Translation table).
Alignment plan is plano de alinhamento; configuração is Settings (round 2 D5).
Pan is deslocar a visualização, not panorâmica (glossary pan).
Reverse is inverter / invertido, never espelhar (glossary Reverse).
